fact: The head of MAMDA states that the state-backed multi-risk climate insurance (Ministry of Agriculture, Finance and MAMDA) covered 1.2 million hectares at the end of 2023 and that MAMDA has become one of the first consumers of satellite imagery and NDVI in Morocco.
title: Multirisque climatique: La Mamda a remboursé plus de 3 milliards de DH aux agriculteurs depuis 5 ans
